data.title: Rejection of tree felling permit application (Ablehnung Fällgenehmigung)
data.summary: Bezirksamt Musterbek (Hamburg) rejected Sophie Mustermann's application of 16 March 2026 to fell a red beech (Rotbuche) at Eppendorfer Stieg 7, finding the tree protected, healthy and stable. The decision is dated 30 April 2026 and can be challenged with an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office (Bezirksamt) has refused permission to cut down a protected tree on your property because it found no unreasonable impairment. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically, or in person at the Bezirksamt if you disagree — the app will show the deadline calculated from when this letter is deemed delivered. If you do nothing by then, the rejection becomes final and the tree may not be felled without a new, successful application. Consider getting advice from a lawyer or environmental consultant if you want to contest the decision.
